subject: Reopened: review CHANGES REQUIRED (1 high, 5 medium, 7 low + first-deploy race)
body:
reviewer-opus: CHANGES REQUIRED at 11b9415. Lead decisions — fix all:

1. HIGH flaky 401: the Aegra auth handler catches AuthUnavailable and answers 503 (with Retry-After) instead of Aegra's 401 path; share the app's DB pool (or guard open() with the lock — no duplicate pools); find and fix the root cause of the transient failure (reproduce under the full agent.spec matrix); regression tests for 503-not-401 and concurrent first requests. agent.spec must pass the full 18-project matrix 3× consecutively.
2. MEDIUM PII: llm.py loads the PrivacyContext for ctx.user_id itself (from profiles/auth.users, cached) and REFUSES a call with a user_id it can't build privacy for; callers can't forget. Tests.
3. MEDIUM search PII: scrub every query (scrub_generic + the user's PrivacyContext) before any outbound request AND before computing the cache key; probe test proving no email/phone/name leaves.
4. MEDIUM SearXNG: add parser + fallback unit tests (medical layers empty; Tavily guard exhausted); document the deferral to segment 22 in docs/MODEL_TESTS.md and docs/PLAN.md with how to enable it.
5. MEDIUM search-media e2e: render a Commons image, a PMC figure and a YouTube embed (origin + referrerpolicy) inside an assistant answer block (via the ping graph's custom block or the diagnostics panel) at all viewports, zero console errors; use recorded search results so it's deterministic.
6. MEDIUM openrouter override: HTTP-mocked (respx) tests of ChatOpenRouter streaming, tool calls, plugins (file-parser engine) and stream_options through llm.py; fix the pyproject comment.
7. LOW per-turn cap: count PROVIDER ATTEMPTS — a turn may make at most 4 provider requests in total across chains; test.
8. LOW PII regex: exempt numbers in unit/range/lab context (e.g. "150000-450000", "12000000 copies", "mg/dL"); tests with clinical strings.
9. LOW capability-aware routing: when tools are bound (or image input / structured output requested), skip candidates lacking that capability (from the model profile / check_models data); fix the yaml comment.
10. LOW Europe PMC: return/cache abstract snippets only when the licence is storable; otherwise title + citation + link, consistent with PubMed.
11. LOW diagnostics UI: chips self-start; friendly error text with request id (no raw JSON); "1 graph" pluralisation; a new ping starts a new thread (or shows only the latest run); budget-exhausted cancels/clears the pending interrupt; distinct "unavailable" status chip with a word; screenshot the streamed (violet) reply state using a recorded stream.
12. LOW e2e quota: blank provider keys for e2e servers unless E2E_LIVE_LLM=1.
13. LOW: daily Tavily usage reconciliation as an Aegra system cron (stores the reading; never blocks); trim unused img-src hosts; "latest"/pathway queries use include_domains from app_config.search; a test that checkpoint retention prunes.
Extra (first-deploy race): move the default-privileges revoke for public into a pre-step of migrate_all BEFORE Aegra's migrations, so Aegra tables are never exposed even on a brand-new project; test on an empty DB.
Re-run unit, db, live (≤10 calls), agent.spec full matrix ×3, integrate, post done.
